description: Create or update the authenticated user's registrant (WHOIS) contact — the name/address/phone/email a domain registry requires to complete a registration or marketplace-domain transfer. Call this when a tool reports error 'registrant_contact_required'. All fields are required except state and organization (state only where applicable). This does NOT charge anything. If a contact already exists, this UPDATES it with the fields you pass — always send the full current set of fields, not just the ones that changed.

email.description: Contact email (defaults to the Atom account email if omitted).

name.description: Full legal name for the registrant contact.

name: create_registrant_contact
